title: C¹ Lusin pieces of a real function that is Lipschitz on an open set (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5, localized)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Lⁿ = volume), let Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be K-Lipschitz on Ω for some K ≥ 0. Then there are C¹ functions h_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ and sets A_k ⊆ Ω (k ∈ ℕ) such that, for every k and every w ∈ A_k, u(w) = h_k(w) and u is Fréchet differentiable at w with derivative Dh_k(w) = fderiv ℝ h_k w; and Lⁿ(Ω ∖ ⋃_k A_k) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith K u Ω → ∃ (h : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (A : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h k)) ∧ (∀ k, A k ⊆ Ω) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ w ∈ A k, u w = h k w ∧ HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ (h k) w) w) ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (Ω \ ⋃ k, A k) = 0
